implemented_guards: canonical row key derivation uses official registration number + circumference bucket + date + venue + race_no + car_no + source_file_sha256
duplicate canonical rows are not counted twice across receipt inputs
qualified unique riders are deduplicated by official registration number
333/333.33 and 400 buckets are both required for cross-circumference qualification

explicit_boundary: This v1 guard validates duplicate semantics and receipt/provenance shape only. It does not itself prove that capture predated PIT cutoff or that contemporaneous official same-race assignment was observed. Those facts must already be established by bound evidence artifacts before a receipt can become formal support.
